notes: S2/F42 (§11.5, §14.9 TOFU predicate): the manifest of container/manifest-context-trusted-tofu, signed by a container-declared device key, with its signature value altered. A manifest signature contributes to L_KEY_TRUST_TOFU only when the context material verified its equation; the failed equation is E_MANIFEST_SIG_INVALID, the pipeline stops at step (5) and the report carries no L_KEY_TRUST_TOFU.
